integrity: Proof reconstruction and a computationally certified finite inequality were checked. Independent mathematical auditing has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem establishes all-exponent local stability for \(0\le p<2\) and an explicit p=7/4 globally better inscribed triangle, not the exact critical global exponent or a classification of all maximizing triangles. The finite integral inequality relies on the displayed monotone Riemann bounds with a reproducible directed-interval check; historical uniqueness remains provisional.
title: A stable but globally suboptimal equilateral triangle for a radial power density
